_note: Hand-curated, not touched by scripts/sync.py's automatic hourly sync — there's no free API or registry that reliably tracks new Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) launches the way price feeds work, so this list is compiled and verified manually against primary sources (regulator announcements, official press releases, reputable crypto press). Scope: notable VASPs (exchanges, custodians, licensed platforms) that verifiably launched or were newly licensed from 2025 onward and are currently live. A candidate is left out entirely rather than guessed at if its launch date, HQ, or basic facts can't be confidently verified. Ask to have it refreshed when a new VASP launches or you spot one.

items.name: Aster
items.primaryBusiness: Decentralized crypto exchange — perpetual futures & spot derivatives trading
items.note: Rebrand of Astherus into Aster on Mar 31, 2025; backed by YZi Labs (formerly Binance Labs). Native ASTER token launched Sept 2025. 562 perpetual markets live as of Aug 2026 (crypto perps plus tokenized-stock and commodity perps); spot side is much smaller (~6 coins, 8 pairs per CoinGecko).

items.name: PantherTrade
items.primaryBusiness: SFC-licensed virtual asset exchange — spot trading
items.note: One of the first two operating licenses Hong Kong's SFC issued in 2025. Currently lists BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, BNB, HYPE, AVAX, LINK, and USDC per its own site.

items.name: YAX
items.primaryBusiness: SFC-licensed virtual asset exchange — spot trading
items.note: Licensed alongside PantherTrade as Hong Kong's first SFC operating licenses of 2025. Parent Tiger Brokers advertises access to 18 cryptocurrencies via its Tiger Trade app, but that figure isn't confirmed as YAX's own listed-token count, so left blank rather than assumed.

items.name: Laser Digital Japan
items.primaryBusiness: Licensed crypto exchange — wholesale liquidity & institutional digital-asset trading
items.note: Nomura's digital-assets subsidiary — Japan's first newly licensed crypto exchange in 4 years (JVCEA member, Kanto Local Finance Bureau reg. #00032). Initially supports BTC, ETH, XRP, BCH, LTC, and SHIB.
